column_description: Full name: 'Operator ID'. Explanation: Primary key for Personnel, representing an operator. Data type: CHAR(8). Example: 'OP4641'.
Full name: 'Operator Name'. Explanation: Name or label for the operator. Data type: VARCHAR(50). Example: 'Joel Wallace'.
Full name: 'Supervisor ID'. Explanation: Identifies a supervisor. Data type: CHAR(8). Example: 'SV7658'.
Full name: 'Supervisor Name'. Explanation: Name of the supervisor. Data type: VARCHAR(40). Example: 'Michael Kaiser'.
